task: Predict VHL mutation status in clear cell renal cell carcinoma of the kidney. Classes: negative vs. positive for mutation. On H&E, VHL-altered tumors typically show classic clear cell renal cell carcinoma morphology with abundant clear cytoplasm, delicate branching vasculature, and nested or alveolar architecture.

classes.0: VHL mutation-negative tumor lacking the most classic clear cell renal cell carcinoma pattern on H&E.
classes.1: VHL mutation-positive tumor with classic clear cell morphology, rich delicate vasculature, and nested or alveolar growth.
